column1: # `translated` is the integrated C engine. Its checkpoint image is architecture-neutral, but
# both guest decoders must independently prove capture, process death, restore, and recapture.
# Native-supervised checkpoint image capture is not implemented yet. Its row deliberately proves
# the pre-launch refusal; changing `contract` to round-trip is part of implementing that backend,
# not a test-only edit. The aarch64 native row is an executable gap because native_supervised.rs is
# currently cfg(x86_64), so a green ARM CI run must not be mistaken for native coverage.
